name: Sector Relative Leadership
summary: A legacy-nine sector relative-leadership study with a failed frozen primary and a separate exploratory full-period estimate.

caveats: The current 11-SPDR Sectors page uses a different population and remains descriptive.
Failed historical evidence must not be presented as a predictive scan or validated edge.

controls: Plain 63-session momentum control on the same signal dates.
methodology.endpoint: Mean decision-date aggregate 63-session target-minus-source return before 2020.
exclusionCriteria: XLC and XLRE are excluded because their histories do not cover the legacy study period.
Missing, conflicting, or partial price coverage fails the historical runner closed.
features: Top/bottom-third rank thresholds for the fixed nine-fund universe.
Every qualifying ordered pair; no top-N or best-pair selection.
inclusionCriteria: All nine legacy ETFs have complete adjusted-price history on the SPY calendar.
A source is weakening and losing rank while a target is strengthening and improving rank.
At least one of the 5-, 20-, or 63-session feature windows confirms.
methodology.inference: A 10,000-draw moving-block bootstrap over decision-date aggregates; the 95% lower bound had to be above zero to pass.
limitations: This is a historical legacy-nine association, not a live trading-edge validation.
Pair events on the same date are dependent, so date aggregates are the primary inference unit.
The 11-SPDR Sectors page is a separate descriptive context.
methodology.period: Frozen primary: complete outcomes ending on or before 2019-12-31.
methodology.population: XLB, XLE, XLF, XLI, XLK, XLP, XLU, XLV, and XLY on the validated SPY session calendar.
methodology.summary: The frozen historical study evaluates all qualifying ordered pairs from the legacy-nine ETF universe and aggregates dependent pairs by decision date.

variations.name: Legacy Nine — Study 1

moreData.rationale: The frozen primary has run once; adding or redefining observations would be a new study rather than more data for this result.

nextSteps: Preserve the failed historical result without promoting secondary diagnostics.
outcome.summary: The frozen pre-2020 primary mean was +0.0833% with a 95% interval from -0.4524% to +0.6362%; the interval crosses zero, so the primary failed.
whatDidNotWork: The primary confidence interval includes zero.
The observed point estimate was far below the study's detectable mean threshold.
whatWorked: The fixed runner produced 81 disjoint signal decisions and 2,611 candidate-pair events.

variations.thesis: When the fixed legacy-nine rotation rule identifies a weakening source and strengthening target sector, the target would outperform the source over the next 63 sessions.

caveats: This variation is exploratory post-outcome work and deliberately has NO_VERDICT.
It does not alter the failed frozen primary or make the 11-SPDR Sectors page predictive.

controls: 1,000 matched random ordered-pair controls over all signal dates.
Plain momentum and rotation-minus-momentum diagnostics over all signal dates.

exclusionCriteria: XLC and XLRE are excluded because their histories do not cover the legacy study period.

features: Top/bottom-third rank thresholds for the fixed nine-fund universe.

methodology.inference: A moving-block bootstrap describes the interval; no pass/fail hypothesis or fresh structural-break test is defined.
limitations: The plan was frozen after the v1 pre-2020 and 2020+ outcomes were known.

methodology.period: Exploratory full history through the frozen 2026-07-24 cutoff.

methodology.summary: The v2 full-period estimate inherits the fixed legacy-nine rule but pools all 108 completed decision dates after the v1 outcome was observed.

variations.name: Full Period — Study 2

moreData.rationale: More historical pooling after the observed outcomes cannot turn this post-outcome plan into a confirmatory test.

nextSteps: Retain the result as exploratory historical context.
Do not use it to lift the descriptive gate for the 11-sector product page.
outcome.summary: The exploratory full-period pooled mean was -0.2277% with a 95% interval from -0.7320% to +0.2757%; it has no confirmatory verdict.
whatDidNotWork: The pooled interval includes zero and the point estimate is negative.
The post-2020 mean was materially lower than the pre-2020 mean.
whatWorked: The completed full-period run reproduced every analytical artifact and source-price hash against its manifest.
